description: Disavow file management: export a project's disavow entries as the exact .txt content Google's disavow tool accepts (support.google.com/webmasters/answer/2648487) — one bare URL per line to disavow that exact page, or `domain:<host>` to disavow an entire domain and its subdomains. FREE (no credits). Save `fileContent` to a .txt file as-is (UTF-8).

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: export_disavow_file
